name: NxNaperville 2022
information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NxNaperville2022#19494-competitor-responsibilities) tab. Please also be sure to review the [Health and Safety](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NxNaperville2022#18867-health-safety) tab to check additional COVID-19 requirements for this competition.

Join our [Facebook group](https://www.facebook.com/groups/2382471798653473/) to get notified when future competitions in the area get announced and to socialize with other speedcubers!

This competition is supported by Midwest and Friends! Join the [Discord Server](https://discord.gg/9eDzJqB7AB) to meet other cubers and get updates about other competitions in the area!
